scope: Corollary 3.2 of the manuscript “Metric Markov Cotype Two of ℓ1” (preprints/Metric-Markov-Cotype-Two-of-l1-October-5-2026/l1-markov-cotype.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 332 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d1977f73e5a70137), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (Mm)m≥0 be an H-valued martingale with respect to a filtration (Fm), taking values in Q and converging almost surely to M∞. If e is an F0-measurable binary vector, then E ∞ ∑︂ m=0 ∥Φ(Mm+1) − Φ(Mm)∥2 1,w ≤ 108 (︁ E∥M∞ − e∥4 H − E∥M0 − e∥4 H )︁ ≤ 108E∥M∞ − e∥4 H. (3.4)
